method.label: Use remainders to form two equations

annotationRationale: The Remainder Theorem supplies equations for the unknown coefficients. Subtraction eliminates b and solves the resulting linear system.
sourceMethod: Followed the official Remainder Theorem alternative, evaluating at 1 and 2 and making the elimination steps explicit.

review.mathCheck: The remainder conditions give a+b=2 and 2a+b=−6. Subtraction yields a=−8, then b=10, so b−a=18, choice E. These coefficients reproduce both stated remainders.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Originally worded, mathematically faithful adaptation of the Remainder Theorem alternative in official Problem 7 on page 6, followed by the same linear-system calculation.
review.annotationCheck: The theorem is stated and applied correctly. Elimination is supporting knowledge; substituting the solved value back into one equation does not require an additional substitution-elimination node.
